# Pop Strap Finder

> Independent guide to straps, cases, chains and bracelets for the Audemars Piguet × Swatch Royal Oak Pop pocket watch (launched 2026-05-16). Affiliate model; no sponsored placements.

## What this site is

Pop Strap Finder is an editorial aftermarket resource for one specific watch: the AP × Swatch Royal Pop. We do not sell straps directly; we recommend straps from third-party makers and marketplaces (Amazon, AliExpress, eBay, Etsy) and earn affiliate commission when readers click out and buy.

## Coverage

- 8 colorway pages (white, pink, green, orange, yellow, red, light blue, navy)
- 8 strap category pages (leather, rubber/FKM, metal bracelet, NATO, chains, cases, lanyards, bundles)
- Strap finder quiz (matches reader to material + budget + colorway)
- Full news & coverage hub (links to WatchTime, Fratello, Worldtempus, Chrono24, Reddit, YouTube)
- Watch specs page (dimensions, lug attachment, water resistance)
- General + compatibility FAQs

## Key facts about the Royal Pop

- Launch date: May 16, 2026
- Format: Pocket watch (Lépine and Savonnette configurations)
- Case: 40mm diameter, 8.4mm thick, Bioceramic
- Lug attachment: Proprietary — not standard spring bars
- Effective strap width: 20mm
- Water resistance: 3 ATM
- Price: $400 (hours/minutes) or $420 (small seconds)
- Availability: Swatch boutiques only, in-store, no e-commerce

## What we are not

- We do not represent Swatch, Audemars Piguet, or the Royal Oak Pop project
- We do not run sponsored content
- We do not sell straps directly (yet)
- "Audemars Piguet," "Swatch," "Royal Oak," "Royal Pop" are trademarks of their respective owners — used nominatively to identify the product our straps fit
